catalogue.label: runs scored at the halfway mark
catalogue.description: Runs the batting side had scored after 10 overs.

catalogue.label: wickets lost at the halfway mark
catalogue.description: Wickets the batting side had lost after 10 overs.

catalogue.label: runs scored in the powerplay
catalogue.description: Runs scored in the powerplay, overs 1 to 6.

catalogue.label: wickets lost in the powerplay
catalogue.description: Wickets lost in the powerplay, overs 1 to 6.

catalogue.label: runs scored in overs 7 to 10
catalogue.description: Runs scored in overs 7 to 10, the stretch just after the powerplay.

catalogue.label: wickets lost in overs 7 to 10
catalogue.description: Wickets lost in overs 7 to 10, the stretch just after the powerplay.

catalogue.label: fours hit
catalogue.description: Fours hit in the first 10 overs.

catalogue.label: sixes hit
catalogue.description: Sixes hit in the first 10 overs.

catalogue.label: dot balls faced
catalogue.description: Balls in the first 10 overs that went for no runs at all.

catalogue.label: extras conceded
catalogue.description: Extras the bowling side gave away in the first 10 overs: wides, no-balls, byes and leg-byes.

catalogue.label: runs in the current partnership
catalogue.description: Runs scored by the pair at the crease since the last wicket fell, as the 10th over ended.

catalogue.label: balls since the last wicket
catalogue.description: Legal balls bowled since the last wicket fell, as the 10th over ended. Equals all the balls bowled if no wicket had fallen.

catalogue.label: wickets in hand
catalogue.description: Wickets still in hand after 10 overs: 10 minus the wickets lost.

catalogue.label: runs at the halfway mark times wickets in hand
catalogue.description: Runs at 10 overs multiplied by wickets in hand. It is high only when a side is scoring fast and still has plenty of wickets to attack with.

catalogue.label: batting team is a full member
catalogue.description: 1 if the batting side is an ICC full member playing a T20 international, otherwise 0. IPL and BBL sides are franchises, not national teams, so every league innings has 0.

catalogue.label: bowling team is a full member
catalogue.description: 1 if the bowling side is an ICC full member playing a T20 international, otherwise 0. Every league innings has 0.

catalogue.label: both teams are full members
catalogue.description: 1 if both sides are ICC full members. Among the innings the agent is judged on this is the same as 'not an IPL or BBL innings', so it repeats what the two league columns say together.

catalogue.label: innings played in the IPL
catalogue.description: 1 if the innings was played in the IPL, otherwise 0. A T20 international innings has 0 in both competition columns.

catalogue.label: innings played in the BBL
catalogue.description: 1 if the innings was played in the BBL, otherwise 0. A T20 international innings has 0 in both competition columns.
